description: This PHP source file defines the HolidayDao class, which provides data access methods for the Holiday entity within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes methods for saving, retrieving by ID or date, checking existing IDs, searching with filters, and deleting holidays.

classes.name: HolidayDao
classes.description: Data access object class for handling Holiday entities, with methods for saving, retrieving, searching, and deleting holidays.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Persists a Holiday entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getHolidayById
methods.description: Retrieves a Holiday entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingHolidayIds
methods.description: Checks for existing holiday IDs in the database from a list of IDs.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchHolidaysPaginator
methods.description: Builds and returns a paginator object for holiday search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHolidayByDate
methods.description: Retrieves a recurring Holiday matching a specific date or, if not recurring, the exact date.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays with specified IDs and returns the number of deleted records.
